scientific_integrity: Analytic proof gives both directions using explicit best-response inequalities; finite tests independently enumerate 8,395 count profiles. Historical-priority uncertainty is disclosed; no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Classification applies to a C–R edge whose other neighbors are stubborn. Its local nonexistence direction is sufficient for whole-network nonexistence, but global sufficiency is restricted to the two-hub network. Finite enumeration corroborates rather than proves the theorem. Earlier matching/anti-matching literature may contain equivalent statements not indexed under these terms.
title: Exact nonuniform stubborn-neighbor obstruction for a conformist–rebel edge
